canon.note: Basic Oracle Brush (121501) 100% total at L6. Skill Samsara, Locked (121502) deals #1 = 240% (L10) Physical DMG to one enemy and marks it with Burden: Burden stores #2 = 2 Skill Point recoveries, then is dispelled. Ultimate Samsara, Closed (121503) is a pure buff: #1 = 60% (L10) ATK and SPD boost equal to #3 = 20% of Hanya's own SPD for #2 = 2 turns; it deals no damage. Talent When an allied target uses Basic ATK/Skill/Ultimate against a Burdened enemy, their DMG dealt increases by 30%, lasting 2 turns; Burden recovers 1 SP per 2 counted attacks. Energy limit 140. BA0: +10% ATK for 1 turn when Burden recovers SP. BA2 (A5): regenerate 2 Energy when Burden dispels.

fixtures.env: Hanya E0 solo vs 3 Physical-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Samsara, Locked (121502) is Hanya's damaging Skill action.
Samsara, Locked hits the designated enemy once per cast (5 Skill casts in the fixture).
Basic Oracle Brush (121501) is used once in the fixture (SP-positive rotation).
Samsara, Closed (121503) is Hanya's Ultimate action.
The Ultimate is a pure buff (121503): it deals no damage — no HIT_START with attackType ult from Hanya.
The Skill marks the target with Burden at 2 SP recoveries (121502 #2).
Hanya's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; it never falls back to a generic attack action.
Samsara, Locked L10 multiplier is 240% of ATK (121502 #1).
Basic Oracle Brush totals 100% at the engine's default Basic Lv6 (121501 ladder tops at 140%).
The Ultimate's buff lasts #2 = 2 turns (121503).
The Ultimate increases ATK by #1 = 60% at L10 (121503).
The Ultimate increases SPD by #3 = 20% of Hanya's own SPD: 205 × 0.2 = 41 flat SPD (121503).
The talent's Burden-triggered bonus increases the attacker's DMG dealt by 30% (121504).
The talent's DMG bonus lasts 2 turns (121504).
Bonus Ability (BA0) grants Hanya +10% ATK for 1 turn when Burden recovers a Skill Point.
Hanya's Ultimate uses the 140-Energy ladder (sp_need 140); over this fixture her action set regenerates exactly 215 Energy (includes BA2's +2 Energy on Burden dispel).
Burden stores SP recoveries (121502 #2) released 1 per 2 counted attacks plus the Basic's own SP gain: 2 SP gained in the fixture.
The talent's DMG bonus lands on the allied attacker that used the ability against the Burdened enemy (solo fixture: Hanya herself).
The Ultimate action starts before its buff application resolves.
Burden must be applied by the Skill before the talent's DMG-bonus buff can trigger.
